item.title: Apple Teams With ROSÉ to Spotlight iPhone 18 Pro Cameras
item.description: Apple partners with Blackpink’s ROSÉ to launch the iPhone 18 Pro in a Shot‑on‑iPhone ad, highlighting a 48‑MP camera, variable aperture, and rig tech.
